title: Block code position set
statement: Let $T$ be a conjunction of literals on $n$ Boolean coordinates with width at most $w$, and let $x\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$. The positions of the block code formed from a set $S$ of literal positions are exactly the images of $S$ under the natural embedding of the term's positions into the first $w$ positions.
hypotheses_covered: The term width is at most $w$
A finite set $S$ of literal positions
